name: Wudang Mountain
hours: Usually 07:30–17:30 (peak season); cableways may close in rain
duration: Half to full day — allow 4–6 h
hl: The Taoist holy mountain of kung fu films — gold-roofed temples on purple peaks
Wudang Mountain ranks among China's most dramatic mountain landscapes, with cloud seas and granite silhouettes.
Plan a full-day visit: cable car up, ridge walks, and the summit viewpoint before the afternoon haze.
how: Fly or take a high-speed train to Shiyan; from the city, a 40–90 min bus/shuttle reaches the scenic area, then cable cars or walking trails take you up.
tips: Start early to beat queues at the cableway and catch clear mountain light.
Altitude rises quickly — carry water, sunscreen and a light jacket even in summer.
